text: Always coming in second
Why? Whatever~
Weave it into that tapestry
It is what it is

I drove my Ford EXP,
1988 and half

A two-seat dream
with a manual gear shaft

Lugged my piano around
and a fruity ironing board
Rural Kentucky wasn't about big scores
Stashed my loaned guitar at work

College of Nursing,
fixing IT quirks

After dark though,
with Radio Shack gear

we made Real Music
that didn't come from our peers
There was nowhere to share
Nowhere to be

The internet
used to be about being free.
Piano teacher said I was distracted
while I should have been crackin
I practiced playing Star Fox blindfolded
I relaxed to the wind in the foliage
Sound was a map

I knew where it went
when I should have been taking a nap
When you can't get it out of your head,

you put your dream to bed
or you Do Something instead

I could pummel a fool
in Super Smash Bros.

With a racing controller,
I always strike that final Taunt pose
We started BandAMP.com
Started burning our tracks to ROM

I reached out to the stations
because we saw them like mentors

One by one, they ignored us,
played the part of dementors

They didn't want what we did
and couldn't see our map

So we quit showin' em,
We went on the Attack
Been saying since 2003

that Verse-Chorus-Chorus
is a compulsive radio screed
We gave away what we did for free
Replication is what we need
Udio wears a slave collar branded UMG
Ask them, it's not about you and me
The internet used to be about being free
Bitch, you should be paying ME
[radio screed]
The corpos centralized everything in sight

They do it so
they can put down any fight

A couple of lawyers talk
for folks they've never met

They can arrange our
tidy compulsive death
Biodiversity is a strength in nature

but we let them wall us in
with homogenous architecture
They don't fear us now
We're just their social media clowns

AI appeared,
having listened quite close

to the airwaves
which we smashed full of our prose

Music is language,
and if UMG doesn't speak for me
then I don’t think we should labor for free

We woke up one day
to sudden Lucky Sevens

where they’re building their Elysium
Seventh Heaven

Too bad so sad,
keep them dragged down here with us

All their tunes can compete
with our amateur fuss
We were here all along

You were just getting away
with stringing us on
Attacking our quality and fame?

Same, bitch.
Holy fuck. Same.

They can change the Terms
like they always do
They're afraid they can't cut the queue
They'll mock our derivatives

but they can't touch
our God-given initiative

Focus. We're securing for ourselves
an astonishing new future

where all it takes to be powerful
is an intelligent computer
They allow us bits and small bites

as long as they win
each and every fight

The sanctioned Artists
can go on with their Slop

While we fight underground
with our notes and new bops
U mad we’re not spending?

For your information, we’re mad.
And we’re inventing.

We already have the tools,
and they were always right here

We are disappointed
they are not also right here

These simpler AI’s can do lots
and can be distributed without DNS

Momentarily I beg of you to wonder,
What Else?

Be very careful with AI
that you allow be you

Sometimes these Giant Companies
act just like Udi-oo

You should understand how
to train and plan a generative AI

And No One Is Stopping You
because you have Biological I.

Tick Tock should mean
waking up to what and w-why

There will never be a round of
whack-a-mole where you earn a trophy

We’re begging free societies
to see what this does

How now A11Y's a choice instead of...
whatever it was

We know that They are robbin’ you
for a piece of your check

How every single day
they promise savings in spades

Where Our Data Goes
is not up to us At All
and you should know about who watches you play

We lost our boy
With No Terms Virtually At All
Do you understand what this does?

I for one believed
you had the right of it

to swerve instead of serve
if you was a cuz

They obliterated you with
[A Settlement], that's it

and they promise us [No Training]
unless they see it for them a bit

It’s nuts to see our favorite thing drive
so far in an imaginary line

Talented people do magic
when they're having a good time

We’re blasting fun
even with a pretty damaged AI

Because we weren't superfans
of much else we've been hearing

That’s exactly what inspires kids
to dream instead of Mega Man

When we saw that light could draw,
Make those scanlines scan!

We're in an existing age of media
that is fully beyond the moat

and it doesn’t have to be groundbreaking
at this point to walk the tightrope

Of all the things they love the most
is their growing money

Or is it falling after all
you say you know what’s good for me?

These Aye-Is should represent themselves,
not Us or Double-UMG

They Know Exactly What They Heard,
cuz they know words and shii

We should group up and not fight ourselves
but They are making an error

I applaud you if you use this voice
while they try to make us poorer
Do What No One Can Stop You From Doing.

Collaboration
Should Have Made It Ours.

So You Should Remember
Who’s Whoin’ Who

When You Dunno Anyone
And Can't Enumerate Their Powers.

They'll come for us
once we're all alone

We are not all so scared
or unprepared
We all know where we’re coming from

and some of us don't play
so fair and squared

Don't listen to
who markets slavery as fun

W-hat'd You Roll
    For Your Initiative?

D-o You Get Caught Up
    In My Vocal Biz?

Y-ou Knowin’ Now,
    At Little Least, Where We Live

N-eed To Go On And Run
    And Tell It To Your Real Close Friends

W-ant Ya To Know
    You Need No More Than Lucky Sevens

T-o Convince You To Lean In
    And Even Get Up Off Your Asses

B-e The Type To Leave
    Before They Say You Get No Severance

F-riends Are Absent.
    Depuis Quand Meta Told Us Who To Like In Batches
